changelog: All commands' --json output now shares one consistent shape: {ok, command, criteria, results, count, warning, error}, with flat venue objects that always carry venue_id, name and booking_url. Payloads shrink 32-97% (info 42KB -> 1.3KB, availability 79KB -> 20KB) with no facts dropped - verified by a fidelity suite that diffs against the raw upstream and fetches sample booking links to confirm they render. Booking links are now embedded in availability, check and range output, so agents no longer need follow-up url calls. The previous unprocessed output remains available via --raw. Human-readable output is unchanged. If you parse --json programmatically, adapt to the new shape or pass --raw.
summary: Find restaurants and check table availability in Israel. Search across multiple dates and venues at once, view menus, and get a booking link to finish on Ontopo. Covers dining and restaurant discovery in Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa, Eilat and 23 more cities. Use for "restaurant reservation", "table booking", "book a restaurant", "dinner reservation", "where to eat in Israel", "מסעדה", "הזמנה", "הזמנת שולחן", "תפריט", "ארוחת ערב", "איפה לאכול", "אונטופו".
